dedupe_keys.name: matlab scripts describing a nonlinear steady state cornering model for an electric city bus

description: Eindhoven University of Technology publishes MATLAB scripts for a nonlinear steady-state cornering model of a six-wheel electric city bus. The multi-body representation parameterises wheel location and orientation. Double rear wheels have individual rotational velocities. The source includes large-angle kinematics, nonlinear Magic Formula tyre forces and lateral load transfer from an elevated centre of gravity. An adapted Newton scheme solves four degrees of freedom. The release contents and related resources follow the native description above. Coverage: The reviewed metadata does not establish a complete common temporal interval. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData descriptive metadata identifies this release. Licence: GPL-3.0. Cost and current distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: The source connects tyre resistance and scrub losses to vehicle energy consumption. It does not establish a validated operating envelope or general applicability to all buses. Scripts, numerical convergence and tyre calibration were not independently tested.
